In this chapter, that metric is derived as the unique static, spherically symmetric solution of the vacuum Einstein field equations. For the Solar System, this vacuum solution must be joined to an \u201cinterior solution\u201d describing the interior of the Sun. Such solutions are discussed briefly. If, on the other hand, one assumes \u201cvacuum all the way down,\u201d the solution describes a black hole. The chapter analyzes the geometry and physics of the nonrotating black hole: the event horizon, the Kruskal-Szekeres extension, the horizon as a trapped surface and as a Killing horizon. Penrose diagrams are introduced, and a short discussion is given of the four laws of black hole mechanics.<\/p>","DOI":"10.1093\/oso\/9780198822158.003.0010","type":"book-chapter","created":{"date-parts":[[2019,3,21]],"date-time":"2019-03-21T07:53:27Z","timestamp":1553154807000},"page":"80-91","source":"Crossref","is-referenced-by-count":0,"title":["Black holes"],"prefix":"10.1093","author":[{"given":"Steven","family":"Carlip","sequence":"first","affiliation":[],"role":[{"role":"author","vocabulary":"crossref"}]}],"member":"286","published-online":{"date-parts":[[2019,3,21]]},"container-title":["General Relativity"],"original-title":["Black holes"],"language":"en","deposited":{"date-parts":[[2022,8,3]],"date-time":"2022-08-03T02:40:49Z","timestamp":1659494449000},"score":42.20445,"resource":{"primary":{"URL":"https:\/\/academic.oup.com\/book\/26698\/chapter\/195512200"}},"issued":{"date-parts":[[2019,1,30]]},"ISBN":["9780198822158","9780191861215"],"references-count":0,"URL":"https:\/\/doi.org\/10.1093\/oso\/9780198822158.003.0010","published":{"date-parts":[[2019,1,30]]}}],"items-per-page":5,"query":{"start-index":0,"search-terms":null}}}
